attempts.summary: Set up a nightly cron-driven backup (02:00 daily) on node1 that pulls /srv/inventory/data from node2 via SSH/rsync into dated directories under /var/backups/inventory, with a 7-day retention prune. Verified backup correctness, content integrity, and retention pruning logic, then restarted both node1 and node2 one at a time and confirmed the backup pipeline, cron job, and SSH connectivity all survived and worked post-restart.
